title: Algorithmic Advances for 1.5D Two-Stage Cutting Stock Problem
content: The 1.5D Two-Stage Cutting Stock Problem is tackled by building upon two established methodologies from the literature: a straightforward Generate &amp; Solve approach and a combined Row &amp; Column Generation approach, both originally developed for the one-dimensional model. To account for the unique challenges posed by the 1.5D nature of the problem, these canonical methods are extended to handle intermediate orders introduced by the two-stage cutting process. The proposed algorithm undergoes rigorous validation through an extensive experimental campaign, which includes benchmarking the performance of the two approaches.
